quantize_and_save_autogptq_format: quantize a model and export it in auto_gptq format with 4-bit asymmetric quantization
quantize_and_save_autoround_format: quantize a model and export it in auto_round format with 4-bit symmetric quantization
quantize_and_save_autoawq_format: quantize a model and export it in auto_awq format using the auto_round:auto_awq hybrid format
export_fp8_static_quantization: export an fp8 static quantized model with configurable static_kv_dtype for key and value projections
export_llm_compressor_format: export a quantized model in llm_compressor format supporting int8 dynamic or w4a16 weight-only schemes
